architecture: MobileSAM (TinyViT image encoder + SAM mask decoder, return_single_mask ONNX export)
inputs: image [1,3,1024,1024]; decoder: image_embedding [1,256,64,64], point_coords [1,N,2] in 1024-space, point_labels [1,N] (1=pos,0=neg), mask_input [1,1,256,256], has_mask_input [1], orig_im_size [2]
outputs: masks (thresholded, orig size), scores (IoU), logits (256x256, for iterative refinement)
source: ONNX export via SAMExporter; files from Kazuhito00/MobileSAM-ONNX-Sample
upstream: MobileSAM (ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM, Apache-2.0) built on Segment Anything (facebookresearch/segment-anything, Apache-2.0)
